a.lede: A new AI-based software program is being launched to help air traffic controllers better navigate their jobs as the crossing guards of America's skies.
a.title: The FAA’s plan to fix air traffic? $875M worth of AI

b.lede: An aircraft equipped with Joby Aviation's autonomy technology flew across the United States without a human pilot taking control at any point.
b.title: Joby Aviation’s 3,100-mile autonomous flight signals its push beyond electric air taxis
